CustomField.description: JSON array of all top-level Campaign IDs created in this run. Populated for GivingPrograms runs where multiple program top-levels are created. For Seasonal and Strategy runs, contains a single-element array matching Last_Top_Level_Id__c. Useful for support investigations and as a target list for future Deep Clone capability.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Stores the Salesforce IDs of all top-level Campaigns created when the setup flow last ran. For Giving Programs runs, this is a JSON array of all program Campaign IDs.
CustomField.label: All Created Top Level IDs (JSON)
